payload.friendly_name: Mutation testing floors, and PIT on packs
payload.purpose_context: The 2026-11-03 test suite assessment (W1, R1) and #239 found that the nightly PIT run gates nothing and never mutates packs, which holds 90 % of the code. The operator ruled to adopt #239 as designed: a fixed floor per module (kernel 65, missions 70, profiles 50, packs by floor5(score - 3)), PIT on packs.domain, packs.application and, by ruling, packs.infra.storage with its own floor; every module's report uploaded with a job summary; an issue opened on a red scheduled run; an ADR ending the experiment status.
payload.purpose_tldr: Make the nightly mutation run fail on a falling score, and extend it to the packs domain, application and storage code where most of the logic lives.

payload.question: Confirm Mission D's extracted requirements (#239 as designed plus rulings)?

payload.wp_title: PIT on packs, measured and floored
The nightly reports every module and alerts on red
Mutation convention plugin and floor check
